name: seo-platform
description: Modular SEO operating platform - Supabase, provider-agnostic SEO core, Qdrant knowledge, pluggable publishing

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @seo/contracts build && pnpm --filter @seo/api build && pnpm --filter @seo/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @seo/contracts test && pnpm --filter @seo/api test && pnpm --filter @seo/web test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @seo/contracts exec vitest run --coverage && pnpm --filter @seo/api exec vitest run --coverage && pnpm --filter @seo/web exec vitest run --coverage
